The condition is os.name == "nt", with no negation, and the guarded execution is in its then arm (s2).
The condition reads the operating system name through os.name, so os fits the property tested (f1:13).

Both supplied versions put their respective regions directly under the single os.name equality condition, with no additional condition (s2, s4). The expression is c1 and its minimum satisfying set has one condition.

The original execution region and the supplied derived region are both within the then arm of the same equality test (s2, s4). Both cited sinks sit directly in the derived region, so no witness hops are needed (s5, s6).
